name: Machi de Uwasa no Hakushaku-sama
source:
Machi de Uwasa no Hakushaku-sama deals with Siena, a young girl who wandered around the forest on her way back home and lost her way in the forest. Siena had lost consciousness out of hunger and someone saved her from the forest. She wanted to return the favour and show her gratitude but….

“You, who trespassed my territory is mine.”

Siena was then assigned to the work of a maidservant, providing her food and shelter but…

[taken from [url=http://animationfreak.livejournal.com/49674.html]Animationfreak's Livejournal[/url]]
translation:
《街頭傳聞的伯爵大人》講述年輕女孩席耶娜的故事。她在回家途中穿過森林，卻不慎迷路，後來因飢餓失去意識，被人救出了森林。她想報答對方、表達謝意，卻……

「擅自闖入我領地的你，現在屬於我。」

此後，席耶娜被安排擔任女僕，以此換取食物和住處，然而……

[摘自[url=http://animationfreak.livejournal.com/49674.html]Animationfreak的Livejournal[/url]]
